info.title: Link in Bio API
info.description: Link-in-bio pages and their blocks, short links, QR codes, tracking pixels, form submissions, analytics and custom domains.

domain.description: The domain you sign in to, without https://

bearerAuth.description: A workspace API key: `Authorization: Bearer osk_...`

apiKeyHeader.name: x-api-key
apiKeyHeader.description: The same workspace API key in the `x-api-key` header.

revision.description: Opaque. Send it back in `If-Match` when changing the page.

disabled.description: Disabled by the platform. Activating does not clear it.

settings.description: `seo`, `utm` and `protection.sensitive`. Passwords and pixel selections are not returned.

content_supported.description: `false` for block types the API cannot edit (commerce, embeds). Their `content` is empty.

content.description: Fields depend on `type`. See `write_schema` in Get the catalogue.

status.description: Queued, then pending DNS, verified, ready, deleted or failed.

post.description:
New pages are created **paused**, with the same starter blocks as the dashboard. Activate with Set page status.

**Required permission:** `biolinks:pages:write`

Themes, fonts, block types with their defaults, and `read_schema` / `write_schema` for each block type, plus which ones are `writable` on your workspace.

**Required permission:** `biolinks:catalog:read`

Lifetime totals, a 7-day trend (today and the 6 days before) and 30-day breakdowns, with timezone and as-of time.

**Required permission:** `biolinks:analytics:read`

Same shape as page analytics. Links record clicks, not views.

**Required permission:** `biolinks:analytics:read`

**Required permission:** `biolinks:submissions:read`
